qnaPage.title: FAQ
qnaPage.sub: Find quick answers to your questions about using TrayStorage Connect.

items.q: How do I sign up for TrayStorage Connect?
items.a: Choose 'Sign Up' on the login screen, enter your email, password and name, and select a role (Admin / Team Member). An admin creates a new company by entering a company name and company code, while a team member only needs the company code received from the admin to join that company. Team members can also sign up without a company code — in that case the company details are entered on the onboarding screen after logging in. Passwords must pass security validation (length and complexity), and emails that are already registered are blocked from signing up again.

items.q: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
items.a: Select 'Forgot password?' on the login screen and a reset link will be sent to your registered email. Clicking the link in the email opens the password reset page, and the new password must also satisfy the security policy to be accepted.

items.q: What is the difference between an admin and a team member?
items.a: Admins manage the entire company — they can create, edit and delete departments, manage users, access documents and categories in every department, view company-wide statistics and post company announcements. Team members work mainly within their own department: they view and upload documents, check documents shared with them, and only see department-level statistics. If the role selected at login does not match the actual account role, the login is rejected.

items.q: I want to delete my account.
items.a: You can do this from Settings or the account deletion page. For verification you re-enter your password, agree to all three items about permanent data deletion, non-recoverability and the grace period, and then type the confirmation phrase exactly to submit the request. Deletion is not immediate — it goes through a grace period, and if you log in again during that period you can choose to cancel the deletion in the warning dialog and restore your account.

items.q: Can I log in with a Naver account?
items.a: Yes, Naver social login is supported. If no company information exists on your first Naver login, you are taken to the onboarding screen to enter details such as the company code before you start using the service.

items.q: How do I upload a document?
items.a: On the Documents (or storage) page, press the upload button, select a file, then choose the storage (subcategory) to save it in and the Confidential / General classification. During upload, OCR automatically extracts the body text so it can be used for content search later.

items.q: Which file formats can I upload?
items.a: PDF is the default, and JPG, JPEG and PNG images can also be uploaded. Images are automatically converted to PDF on upload, so the archived format stays consistent.

items.q: Is there a limit on the number of documents I can upload?
items.a: Yes, the limit depends on your company's subscription plan. The free plan allows up to 100 documents and 1 GB of storage. Documents moved to the trash are excluded from the count, so deleting documents frees up room for new uploads. Higher plans have larger or unlimited quotas.

items.q: Can I modify a document after uploading it?
items.a: You can replace the document file itself with a new file (re-upload), and the OCR text is refreshed at the same time. You can also change metadata such as the classification (Confidential / General).

items.q: Does deleting a document remove it permanently?
items.a: No. Deleting moves the document to the trash (soft delete) and you can restore it whenever you want. Permanent removal only happens when you run 'Delete Permanently' or 'Empty Trash' from the trash.

items.q: How do I restore a document from the trash?
items.a: On the Trash page, press 'Restore' on the document and it returns to its original location. The trash also supports deleting individual items permanently and emptying everything at once.

items.q: How does document search work?
items.a: The search bar at the top searches document names and categories, and the body text extracted by OCR is included in the search as well. You can also ask the AI chatbot in natural language, such as "find documents that mention ○○", or search by period, such as "documents uploaded this week / last month".

items.q: How are documents containing personal information handled?
items.a: During OCR processing, personal information patterns such as resident registration numbers, driver's license numbers, passport numbers, card numbers, mobile and landline numbers and email addresses are automatically detected and masked. The masked text is what gets stored in the search index, reducing the risk of exposing sensitive information.

items.q: What is the difference between confidential and general documents?
items.a: It is a classification you set at upload time. Documents marked as confidential are shown with a separate marker and require careful handling, while general documents are viewed within the scope of department permissions. Actual access is controlled by department and permission policies.

items.q: Can I share a document with someone else?
items.a: Yes, you can share a document with specific users and grant either view or download permission. The recipient is notified when a document is shared, and received documents appear in 'Shared Documents'. Sharing can be revoked at any time.

items.q: How is the category structure organized?
items.a: The hierarchy is Department → Category (parent category) → Storage (subcategory) → Document. Documents are actually kept at the storage level, and each storage can have attributes such as NFC, storage location, management number, expiry date and a color label.

items.q: How do I create a new category or storage?
items.a: An admin (or a user with permission) creates a category inside the relevant department and then adds storages beneath it. When creating a storage you can also set the storage location, management number, color label and expiry policy.

items.q: What does storage location mean?
items.a: It refers to the physical place where the paper document is kept (for example, Cabinet A-2 or the 3rd-floor archive). Recording a storage location on a storage lets you find the digital document and its physical location together through an NFC scan or a search.

items.q: How do I add or edit a department?
items.a: Only admins can add, edit or delete departments in department management. When a company is first created a 'Default Department' is generated automatically, and newly joined team members are placed in the company's first department unless assigned elsewhere. The number of departments is subject to the plan limit (up to 3 on the free plan).

items.q: Can I set an expiry date on a category or storage?
items.a: Yes. If you set an expiry date at the storage level, access to the documents in that storage is blocked automatically once the date passes (you do not need to set an expiry date on each individual document). Advance notifications are sent 30 days and 7 days before expiry, and another notification is sent at the moment of expiry.

items.q: How do I register an NFC tag?
items.a: On the storage detail screen, select 'NFC registration' and hold the NFC tag close to your device — the storage information is written to the tag and linked. NFC availability depends on your plan (the free plan includes 0 NFC tags), and the related buttons are hidden on devices that do not support NFC.

items.q: What happens when I scan an NFC tag?
items.a: Press the NFC button at the bottom left of the screen to scan. When a tag is recognized you are taken automatically to the linked storage (or category) page, where you can immediately see the related document list and the storage location. Older-style tags (which store a category code or name) are also recognized for compatibility.

items.q: How can I check whether my phone supports NFC?
items.a: The app automatically detects whether your device supports NFC. If it does not, the NFC button is simply not shown. Android and iOS native apps as well as Web NFC environments are supported, and progress plus success or failure is shown while scanning.

items.q: I lost an NFC tag, or I want to reuse one.
items.a: You can unlink NFC from a storage or write the information to a new tag. To prevent the same UID from being linked to more than one storage, the existing link is cleared before the new registration.

items.q: What information can I see on the dashboard?
items.a: You can check key indicators such as monthly upload trends, document distribution by category and department, and rate of change. It also provides quick access based on recently visited storages and your favorites.

items.q: Can team members see statistics too?
items.a: Team members can only see statistics for their own department; company-wide statistics and comparisons between departments are available to admins only.

items.q: I want more detailed statistics.
items.a: Advanced statistics are a feature of the higher subscription plans. The free plan provides basic statistics, and upgrading your plan unlocks more detailed analysis.

items.q: What can the AI chatbot help with?
items.a: The chatbot at the bottom right of the screen helps with document search (by content, period or department), guidance on how to use the system, checking category and department status, and looking up team members. Answers include links that take you straight to the relevant document or page.

items.q: Can I choose the AI model? Can I use voice?
items.a: Yes. At the bottom of the chatbot you can choose between GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.4 / GPT-4.1 / GPT-4o, and your choice is saved. The microphone button enables voice input (STT), and in voice mode answers can also be read aloud.

items.q: Are there usage limits? Is my conversation history saved?
items.a: AI queries have a monthly usage limit per plan (20 per month on the free plan). Conversation history is kept for the current session only and is completely deleted when you log out, for security.

items.q: What is the difference between admin and team announcements?
items.a: Admin announcements target everyone in the company, while team announcements are shown to members of that department. Where you write them depends on your permissions.

items.q: How do I write an announcement?
items.a: Admins can create, edit and delete company announcements from the announcement management menu. Team-level announcements are managed on the team announcements screen.

items.q: Are there separate announcements from the service provider?
items.a: Yes. There are separate system announcements published by the service operations team, and notices about maintenance, updates and other service-wide matters appear in a designated place.

items.q: What notifications can I receive?
items.a: You receive notifications for document activity (created, deleted, shared), category changes (created, deleted) and expiry management (storage nearing expiry / expired). Admins additionally have an option to limit the notification scope to 'my department only'.

items.q: Can I turn notification types on or off?
items.a: Yes. In notification settings you can toggle document creation, deletion and sharing, category changes and expiry notifications individually, and changes are saved immediately.

items.q: How do I receive push notifications?
items.a: When you log in on the mobile app, the push identifier is registered automatically so you can receive push notifications. Notification permission must be granted on your device / OS for them to arrive properly.

items.q: Is there a dark mode?
items.a: Yes, light and dark themes are supported and can be switched in settings. The PDF preview screen keeps a white background even in dark mode for readability.

items.q: Which languages are supported?
items.a: Five languages are supported — Korean, English, Japanese, German and Chinese — and both the interface and the chatbot responses follow the language you select.

items.q: How do I report inappropriate content?
items.a: Press the 'Report' button on the document or post, choose a reason (spam/advertising, inappropriate content, sexual content, abuse/harassment, violence, false information, exposure of personal information, copyright infringement, illegal information, other), add details and submit. The operations team reviews and acts on reports, and duplicate reports about the same target are prevented automatically.

items.q: How do I get in touch or ask for help?
items.a: Submit an inquiry through the in-app inquiry feature and the operations team will reply. For login-related problems such as a suspended account or a data mismatch, follow the guidance message and contact customer service.
